key: Behold, My servant shall prosper, He shall be exalted and lifted up, and shall be very high.
s: Before onlookers tell of a servant despised, crushed and cut off from the living, the LORD speaks of him; Rashi, on 52:13 and 53:3, reads the servant as Jacob, all Israel spoken of as one man, whose righteous will prosper at the end of days.
